name: Pack of Cigarettes
description: A soft pack, crushed flat on one corner, with most of a row still in it. Nobody is quitting this year.

name: Somebody's Good Cigar
description: Kept in a metal tube for an occasion that never arrived. It gets smoked by whoever decides tonight counts.

name: Hip Flask
description: Dented steel, warm from a pocket, with a mouthful of something harsh left in the bottom of it.

name: Deck of Playing Cards
description: Worn soft at the corners and short of a card or two, which everybody agrees to pretend they have not noticed.

name: Dice and Leather Cup
description: A cracked cup and a handful of bone dice that rattle like something small running across a floor.

name: Creased Photograph
description: A picture of people on a beach, folded and unfolded so often the faces have started to go soft along the crease.

name: Unsent Letter
description: Written in a steady hand, addressed, and never posted. Reading it is either a comfort or a mistake, depending on the night.

name: Brass Harmonica
description: Tarnished, missing its case, and still perfectly in tune. Whoever plays it is not as good as they think they are.

name: Wind-Up Music Box
description: A lacquered box with a crank on the side. It plays something slow and a little flat, and then it runs down.

name: Dog-Eared Paperback
description: Swollen with damp and read to pieces. The ending is missing, which nobody minds as much as they expected to.

name: Travelling Chess Set
description: A folding board with pegged pieces, so a game can sit half finished on a crate for days without anybody knocking it over.

name: Wooden Rosary
description: Beads rubbed pale where a thumb has gone over them, on a cord that has been knotted back together more than once.
